comment: dokick.c ghitm() 329-336 and 344: a debug Samurai level-teleports into Tuktoyaktuk's general store on Dlvl 5 (seed from a bounded 7302101-7302400 scan for a ^V arrival in a shop), picks up an unpaid spellbook and ^T-teleports to the corridor north of the door, robbing the shop. Thrown gold that the pursuing keeper catches covers the 356-zorkmid loss ('The amount covers its recent losses.', make_happy_shk()). Back at the door, ya thrown at the keeper anger him without a robbery, and the rest of the gold gets 'Thanks, scum!'. The priest (350-351) and vault guard (353-365) branches need a temple priest and a vault guard and are not covered here.
